strings: r_c0 comes over to check on m_c, since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} been silently standing in place and staring for a few heartbeats... It seems like {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might have gone absent.
m_c stops mid action, just staring blankly for a period as the sunlight shifts over {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nose.
Carefully, m_c's denmates check on {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} just staring at a spot on the wall.
m_c blinks and the camp seems to have moved around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. Awkwardly {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/shuffle/shuffles}, trying to figure out what tasks have been assigned.
When m_c blinks, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/find/finds} {PRONOUN/m_c/self} no longer in the clearing but resting in the shade, a Clanmate close by to keep watch.
